# Veridex Protocol Documentation

> Veridex Protocol — cross-chain passkey authentication, autonomous agent payments, and on-chain identity. Build wallets, bridge tokens, and enable AI agents to pay autonomously using WebAuthn passkeys.

Docs site: https://docs.veridex.network
Full docs for LLMs: https://docs.veridex.network/llms-full.txt
API (plain text, filterable): https://docs.veridex.network/api/docs-for-llm
GitHub: https://github.com/veridex-protocol/

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](/getting-started/quick-start): Create a passkey wallet in 5 minutes
- [Installation](/getting-started/installation): Install @veridex/sdk and @veridex/react
- [Core Concepts](/getting-started/concepts): Hub-and-spoke architecture, passkeys, vaults, Wormhole
- [FAQ](/getting-started/faq): Common questions about the protocol

## Guides

- [Create Wallet](/guides/create-wallet): Passkey registration, vault address derivation
- [Send Tokens](/guides/send-tokens): Prepare and execute transfers, gasless payments
- [Cross-Domain Passkeys](/guides/cross-domain-passkeys): Share passkeys across origins
- [Gasless Transactions](/guides/gasless-transactions): Relayer-sponsored transfers
- [Session Keys](/guides/session-keys): Delegated signing without repeated biometrics
- [Spending Limits](/guides/spending-limits): Per-transaction and daily spending limits
- [Balance Watching](/guides/balance-watching): Real-time balance subscriptions
- [Cross-Chain](/guides/cross-chain): Bridge tokens between chains via Wormhole
- [Error Handling](/guides/error-handling): Unified error codes, retry strategies
- [React Hooks](/guides/react-hooks): @veridex/react hooks — usePasskey, useBalance, useTransfer
- [Enterprise Manager](/guides/enterprise-manager): Batch vault operations for enterprises
- [Agent Payments](/guides/agent-payments): AI agent payment system with session keys
- [Agent Identity](/guides/agent-identity): On-chain agent identity (ERC-8004)
- [Examples](/guides/examples): Runnable code examples for every feature
- [Multisig Wallet](/guides/multisig-wallet): M-of-N multisig with off-chain and on-chain modes
- [Advanced Patterns](/guides/advanced-patterns): VAA verification, session lifecycle

- [Aptos](/chains/aptos): Aptos spoke integration
- [Sui](/chains/sui): Sui spoke integration

- [Stacks](/chains/stacks): Stacks (Bitcoin L2) spoke integration

## Key Packages

- `@veridex/sdk` — Core SDK: createSDK, passkey auth, transfers, bridging, sessions
- `@veridex/react` — React hooks: VeridexProvider, usePasskey, useBalance, useTransfer, useMultiChainPortfolio
- `@veridex/agentic-payments` — Agent SDK: createAgentWallet, session-key payments, x402

## Supported Chains (Testnet Wormhole IDs)

| Chain | Wormhole ID | Type |
|-------|-------------|------|
| Base | 10004 | Hub (EVM) |
| Optimism | 10005 | Spoke (EVM) |
| Arbitrum | 10003 | Spoke (EVM) |
| Ethereum | 10002 | Spoke (EVM) |
| Solana | 1 | Spoke |
| Aptos | 22 | Spoke |
| Sui | 21 | Spoke |
| Starknet | 50001 | Spoke |
| Stacks | 50003 | Spoke |
